_comment: The PharmAgentics platform questionnaire (core-008). Edit the wording, add or remove questions, and bump `version`; no code changes are needed. Item types: agree5 (1-5 agreement), nps (0-10), choice (one of), multi (any of), text (free text, `max` characters). `scoring.umux_lite` names the two UMUX-Lite items (capabilities, then ease of use); feedback.py scores them. Version 1 used the ten-statement SUS (`scoring.sus`); its stored responses still load and summarize. Responses record the version they answered.
title: PharmAgentics platform questionnaire
intro: About a minute. Answer for PharmAgentics as a whole, not one briefing. Skip anything that does not apply. Please do not write names or other personal details in the text answer.

items.text: When I checked, I could see where each number came from.
How likely are you to recommend PharmAgentics to a colleague?
What one thing would you change?
